long_lines

The long-line rule.

Legend

  • A type prints as a C++ declaration: class when every member is private and struct when one is public, with the members of all its impls merged in.
  • static marks a function with no receiver; () mut marks one that takes &mut self, and a method with no marker takes &self.
  • : Clone, Debug is the base list: the standard traits a type derives or implements, by short name.
  • A type lists its data first, its fields or variants, then its other members. internal: opens the pub(crate) members, private: the rest, and public: goes back to public; a label prints only where the access changes from what the keyword gives, so a type can show one twice.
  • A module's item that is not public gets // internal or // private above it.
  • [[...]] is an attribute that shapes the API or its wire format, such as [[must_use]] or [[serde(rename = "id")]].
  • implements: Trait for Type; is an impl with no declared type to attach to, such as a blanket impl.
  • MACRO marks a macro definition, an invocation, a derive from another crate, or an attribute macro.
  • A doc comment prints as prose, and backticked text prints in the code font; a member's comment reflows as one paragraph.

MACROS: none

Unconnected types

Container

A header whose where clause moves.

class Container<K, V>
    where K: Ord + Clone + std::fmt::Debug + Send + Sync, V: Clone + Send
{
    keys: Vec<K>,
    values: Vec<V>,
}

Registry

A header whose where clause breaks one predicate per line.

class Registry<K, V, S>
    where
        K: Ord + Clone + std::fmt::Debug + Send + Sync + 'static,
        V: Clone + Send + Sync + std::fmt::Debug,
        S: std::hash::BuildHasher + Default
{
    keys: Vec<K>,
    state: S,
    values: Vec<V>,
}

Wide

Members that test the long-line rule.

struct Wide
{

This doc comment line is deliberately longer than eighty columns so it shows comments never wrap.
    a_field_with_a_very_long_type: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, std::collections::BTreeSet<u64>>,
    static exactly_at_80(first_value: u64, second_value: u64) -> Option<String>
    static fits_with_comment(value: u64) -> u64 // a trailing comment that pushes past eighty
    static huge(
        an_extremely_long_parameter_name_for_testing: std::collections::BTreeMap<String, Vec<u64>>)
    static long_first_line(
        argument_number_one: u64,
        argument_number_two: u64) -> u64
    static one_over_limit(first_value: u64, second_value: u64) -> Option<String>
    static tail_also_breaks(
        argument_number_one: u64,
        argument_number_two: u64) ->
        std::collections::BTreeMap<String, Vec<u64>>
    register(
        name_of_the_thing: str&,
        handler_for_the_thing: Box<dyn Fn(u32)>,
        priority: u8) mut
    register_bounded<T>(
        name: str&,
        value: T) mut
        where T: Clone + Send + Sync + std::fmt::Debug + std::hash::Hash
    route<R, L>(
        read: R,
        load: L)
        where
            R: Fn(String) -> Option<String> + Send + Sync + 'static,
            L: Fn(String, Option<u32>) -> Result<String, u8> + Send
}
